title: Logspace membership of the query bank
statement: Let $f$ map finite Boolean strings to finite Boolean strings. Suppose its output length is bounded by a polynomial in the input length, and that both indexed languages—testing whether the $i$th output bit is true and testing whether the output has length greater than $i$—are decidable in logarithmic space. Then, for each of the four languages in the bank consisting of the input-bit query, the input-length query, and the corresponding two queries for $f$, that language is decidable in logarithmic space.
